free_text_notes.physician_note: 53-year-old woman with type 2 diabetes, alcohol use disorder in remission, admitted 4/24 with right lower lobe community-acquired pneumonia. Afebrile for 48 hours on IV antibiotics; switched to oral today. The patient reads with glasses. All written discharge materials were provided in large print at the patient's request. The patient confirmed they could read and understand everything.
